1.consolidated_definition: Del Rosario lo define como: ‘estar en disposición de actuar enérgicamente, sin rodeos ni componendas’. “Ya mismo le dan una cogía’e cuello porque el director no come cuentos.” Juan Antonio Ramos, Vive y vacila, p. 79.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To be in a state of readiness to act energetically without hesitation or compromise. "They will give him a good scolding right away because the director doesn't tolerate lies."
